sloka: अस्त्रेण हनुमान् मुक्तो नात्मानमवबुध्यत ।कृष्यमाणस्तु रक्षोभिस्तैश्च बन्धेर्निपीडितः ।। ५.४८.५२।।।।
transliteration: astreṇa hanumān mukto nātmānamavabudhyata ।kṛṣyamāṇastu rakṣobhistaiśca bandhernipīḍitaḥ ।। 5.48.52।।।।

translations.english: The cruel ogres hit Hanuman with sticks and fists and dragged him to the presence of the demon lord.
